comparison.objective: Diagnose stuck valves from flow indicators and place tags; candidate physically tunes and locks a damper from dynamic response.
comparison.physical_skill: Causal visual diagnosis followed by tag placement versus tool alignment, collar manipulation, torque-limited locking, and guarded test operation.
comparison.success_condition: One tag on each stuck valve versus two energy-qualified safe stops with retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Both include diagnosis, but PR-250 tests symbolic pneumatic inference and tagging, not physical parameter adjustment or retention.
